articles.headline: NBA Cup quarterfinals: Live updates, results, takeaways
articles.description: The NBA Cup quarterfinals continue Wednesday night, when the Oklahoma City Thunder square off with the Phoenix Suns and the San Antonio Spurs take on Los Angeles Lakers. Follow along for live updates.

articles.description: The Oklahoma City Thunder are favorites to repeat as champions, with Denver and Houston next in line.

articles.headline: Sources: Lakers to use standard court for NBA Cup quarterfinal
articles.description: The Lakers will host the Spurs on their standard court in the NBA Cup quarterfinals Wednesday, rather than their bright yellow alternative Cup court, which had been flagged for its slippery surface, sources told ESPN.
